# Phase Two: Architecture Review Checklist

Boruch Hashem. Blessed is He.

The Awtsmoos gives expansion its boundary: every new search doorway needs Gevurah around visibility, canonical identity, errors, and access control.

## Improvements the final design must include where repository evidence supports them

1. Server-visible page title.
2. Server-visible meta description.
3. Canonical URL.
4. Correct robots directive.
5. Open Graph title.
6. Open Graph description.
7. Open Graph URL.
8. Semantic H1.
9. Semantic main/article content.
10. Crawlable internal links.
11. Stable public URL per entity.
12. 404 for missing public entities.
13. Noindex for non-public surfaces.
14. Sitemap discovery.
15. Sitemap inclusion for public entities.
16. Robots.txt sitemap declaration.
17. Structured data where content type maps cleanly.
18. No dependency on user-agent cloaking.
19. JavaScript enhancement remains functional.
20. Escaping/sanitization of fetched content.
21. Avoid duplicate canonical paths.
22. Avoid indexing query-state variants.
23. Preserve Hebrew directionality.
24. Preserve existing API authorization boundaries.
25. Cache expensive public render data if runtime evidence requires it.
26. Keep server failures from returning misleading 200 shells.
27. Make metadata derive from the same entity data as visible content.
28. Ensure list/index pages expose links without JS.
29. Ensure Road/reader navigation exposes adjacent discoverable links when appropriate.
30. Add regression checks for HTML-without-JS responses.
